'''Wintumber Island''' is an island south of the [[Isle of Souls]]. It requires 63 [[Sailing]], unboosted, to moor on.

It contains a [[crab monument]] that can be charted. Doing so while on the island will also unlock the [[crab dance]] emote and gives a [[medallion fragment]].
If the player has already charted the monument, the emote and medallion fragment can still be obtained by approaching the monument and attempting to chart it again.

If you teleport away from the island, you will need to retrieve your boat via a [[Shipwright]], use one of the [[boat#Teleportation|boat teleportation]] spells, or be brought to the island by another player, as there is no other way to get to the island than with a player-owned ship.

There is also a pile of inconspicuous rocks for building an Elite [[STASH]] unit, several [[lantern fishing]] spots, as well as 11 [[Sand Crab|Sand Crabs]].

==Transportation==
* The closest island with a teleport is [[Deepfin Point]], located to the north-west of Wintumber Island. Players can teleport to Deepfin Point with the [[Sailors' amulet]], [[Summon Boat|summon their boat]] or have [[Shipwright Sornik]] recover it, and then sail south-east.
